subject.title: [security] Diagnostic redaction can leave credential suffixes after punctuation in bearer/header values

question: Should this public security report be fixed as synchronized Worker and Go diagnostic-redaction hardening, or intentionally narrowed to the Worker coordinator path named in the report?
rationale: The bug is source-confirmed, but maintainer security intent should set the repair scope because the documented guarantee covers coordinator diagnostics and doctor output, and the Go helper appears to share the same token boundary.

options.title: Harden both redactors
options.body: Update the Worker and Go diagnostic redaction helpers with aligned punctuation-bearing credential tests so the documented boundary stays consistent.

options.title: Patch Worker only
options.body: Limit this issue to coordinator diagnostics if maintainers intentionally want CLI and doctor behavior handled separately.

recommendation.title: Harden both redactors
recommendation.body: Update the Worker and Go diagnostic redaction helpers with aligned punctuation-bearing credential tests so the documented boundary stays consistent.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the documented redaction surface in the release commit and provided recent maintainer security signoff on the related bearer-redaction hardening.
